structured.feedback: The description is about 170 words in Markdown with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. Its claims come from the product details, and it leaves out weaknesses, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are the weak feature/benefit separation, the "rich, long-lasting bubbles" claim that the reviews undercut, and the extra note after the description.
